import math
th=math.radians(9)
assert abs(math.tan(4*th)*math.tan(6*th)-1)<1e-9
v=1/math.tan(5*th)
opts=[math.sqrt(3),-math.sqrt(3),-1,1]
assert abs(v-opts[3])<1e-9
for i in range(3): assert abs(v-opts[i])>1e-6

from fractions import Fraction as F
r=1/F(4,3)+1/F(2)
v=1/r*60
opts=[F(75),F(55),F(48),F(100)]
assert v==opts[2]
for i in (0,1,3): assert v!=opts[i]
